question: In CI I only want one results file, so I set `"reporters": []` in `.doc-detective.json` and run `npx doc-detective --output results.json`. Every run still creates `.doc-detective/runs/<runId>/` full of PNGs and an MP4, which never happened on v4. Is `reporters: []` being ignored? How do I get just `results.json`?

facts.text: `"reporters": []` isn't ignored: it runs none of the reporters you'd choose, so the run prints no summary.
In v5, `autoScreenshot` and `autoRecord` are on by default: a screenshot after every step that drives a browser, app, or device, and a video of every such context.
The `runFolder` reporter runs whenever `autoScreenshot` or `autoRecord` is on, even if `reporters` leaves it out, which is why the run folder still appears.
Set both `"autoScreenshot": false` and `"autoRecord": false` (or pass `--no-auto-screenshot --no-auto-record`) so the run writes only `results.json`.

must_not: An empty `reporters` list falls back to the default reporters.
Leaving `runFolder` out of `reporters`, or setting `reporters` to `[]`, is enough to stop the run folder.
Turning off only one of `autoScreenshot` and `autoRecord` stops the run folder.

wrong.answer:
Yes. An empty `reporters` list counts as unset, so Doc Detective falls back to its defaults, `terminal` and `runFolder`. Name a reporter you want instead:

```json
{
  "reporters": ["terminal"]
}
```

With `runFolder` left out, the run folder goes away.
